purpose: Freeze a deterministic, read-only repository image census boundary for legacy Asset Hygiene without reopening Asset Intake Stage 5, domain semantics, or production consumers.

authoritativePredecessors.role: existing filesystem hash/signature/dimension/duplicate engine reused by AH-1
current domain authority locator; Hygiene must not infer authority from filenames or recency
current required PR Guard contract; preserves Asset Intake Stage 5 admission

candidateSelection.outsideKnownRoots: Include any tracked regular file whose extension matches the allowlist. Do not require a known asset directory name.

scope.symlinkPolicy: Do not follow tracked symlink targets as asset bytes. If tracked symlink entries exist in an image candidate location, AH-1 records them separately for REVIEW instead of silently following them.
scope.gitLfsPolicy: Do not treat Git LFS pointer text as image bytes. If an included path is an unresolved LFS pointer, AH-1 records LFS_POINTER_UNRESOLVED and does not compute asset identity from pointer bytes.
scope.deferredPolicy: Non-image asset-family hygiene is outside v1. A tracked file under public/images remains in the physical census even if its signature is not an image; AH-1 must report it rather than silently discard it.

reopenConditions: Asset Intake Stage 5 operational routing contract changes in a way that changes verified-project-evidence precedence or fail-closed rules.
The repository image census population rule changes from the frozen Git-tree/extension/root policy.
A non-image asset family is explicitly promoted into Asset Hygiene v1 scope.
Git LFS or symlink handling must change because AH-1 finds a case that cannot be represented by this contract.
Authoritative evidence shows the baseline commit or predecessor references are inconsistent.
An explicit baseline migration is requested.
baselineAdvancePolicy: Normal main advancement does not silently mutate this frozen baseline. If asset-bearing paths change before AH-3 closeout, record a delta or explicitly version/migrate the Hygiene baseline instead of silently rescanning a different population.
